source_name: ARES — Administrativní registr ekonomických subjektů (REST API)
license: Open data (otevřená data; attribute ARES/MF ČR — confirm exact terms)
rate_limits: tens of thousands of queries/day; can be blocked if abused
notes: Authoritative aggregator API run by the Ministry of Finance. Single GET /{ico} returns rich JSON (name, DIČ, legal form, structured address with NUTS/obec/okres codes, CZ-NACE, per-source registration status). POST /vyhledat searches with paging (start/pocet, pocetCelkem). Verified live: HTTP 200 for IČO 00006947 and 27082440 (Alza.cz a.s.). IČO is the 8-digit company id; DIČ = CZ + IČO. Best API spine.

source_name: Veřejný rejstřík — Justice open data (dataor.justice.cz, full + actual XML/CSV)
license: Open data (CKAN portal; license field empty per package — confirm exact terms with MSp)
data_freshness: monthly full + frequent incremental; CKAN packages per legal-form/court/year
notes: CKAN portal with 9,496 packages: {legalform}-{full|actual}-{court_region}-{year} (sro, as, pobspolek, sf, …). full = all historical records, actual (Platný výpis) = current valid extract. Verified: downloaded as-actual-praha-2026.xml.gz (15 MB → ~192 MB, ~16,758 a.s.). The deepest open structured register: share capital, officers (with DOB → PII), shareholders for a.s., boards, insolvency, activity. Bulk spine. NOTE: links 302-redirect (use -L).

source_name: Sbírka listin — collection of deeds incl. financial statements (účetní závěrka)
license: Public register documents (free to view; confirm reuse terms)
fields_observed: účetní závěrka (financial statements: rozvaha/balance sheet, výkaz zisku a ztráty/income statement)
notes: Financial statements are filed into the Sbírka listin of the public register and are FREE to view at or.justice.cz (vypis-sl-firma?subjektId=...). BUT they are document-based (mostly scanned/native PDF) — NOT structured open data, no official XBRL/CSV of figures. Structured financials require OCR/parsing or a commercial provider. Reachability verified (HTTP 200). Join on IČO via the subjektId.

source_name: ARES — open data bulk export (otevřená data)
license: Open data (MF ČR open-data portal; confirm exact terms)
notes: MF ČR publishes a bulk export of ARES economic subjects on its open-data portal (data.mf.gov.cz/topics/ares). Alternative to per-IČO API calls for full-population loads. Page is JS-rendered; resolve exact dataset/resource URLs via the portal. Use justice_vr_bulk for the deepest register fields; this for the ARES-side aggregated population.

source_name: RES — Registr ekonomických subjektů (ČSÚ statistical business register)
organization: Český statistický úřad (Czech Statistical Office, ČSÚ)
notes: Statistical business register feeding ARES (stavZdrojeRes). Strong for CZ-NACE activity, institutional sector and size category. Also exposed via ARES; use directly when statistical attributes are needed.

source_name: Registr plátců DPH / VAT payer register (rozšiřená/MFČR + VIES)
notes: DIČ (VAT/tax id) is normally CZ + IČO. The Finanční správa 'Registr DPH' also flags unreliable VAT payers (nespolehlivý plátce) and published bank accounts. VIES validates a supplied DIČ. Enrichment/validation, not a company master.

Trade licensing register; covers sole traders (OSVČ) and licensed activities. Exposed via ARES (stavZdrojeRzp). Useful for activity/licence detail, especially for entities not in the Veřejný rejstřík.

organization: Ministerstvo vnitra ČR / Digitální a informační agentura
notes: National open-data catalog (DCAT-AP, SPARQL endpoint). Discovery hub that indexes ARES, Justice VR, ČSÚ RES and many other datasets. Use to resolve exact dataset/resource URLs and licences.
